name: Seeds of Sustainability Grants
summary: Small annual grants for locally led conservation projects in the tropics, such as species protection and habitat restoration, open to small non-profits, community groups, small businesses and individuals.

amount.note: First-time applicants up to $5,000; $10,000 or more a year only for invited Conservation Partners

reporting: Periodic short progress updates, requested weekly, monthly or bimonthly depending on project length.

eligibility.rule: Not be engaged primarily in religious or political activities
Align the project with at least one Ceiba Conservation Priority
Have a total annual budget below $500,000

documents: Letter of support, if an individual or other applicant

status.quote: The 2026/27 Seeds of Sustainability grant cycle is now officially closed.

applicant_types.quote: Non-profit organizations, community organizations or associations, small businesses, and individuals from developing countries in the tropics are eligible to apply.

geography.quote: Projects must be carried out in a country within the tropics, and align with at least one of Ceiba's Conservation Priorities.

access.quote: Applicants must first complete the Eligibility Check using the button above. If you meet the criteria, you will then be directed to the application link

window.quote: Call for Applications Opens: April 15, 2026 Application Deadline: May 15, 2026

amount.quote: Anyone applying for the first time to for a Seeds of Sustainability grant may request up to $5,000 maximum. Conservation Partners: First-time grant recipients who demonstrate successful completion of their project, may be invited to join our Conservation Partner network and be eligible to apply for $10,000 (or more) annually.

co_finance_required.quote: Individual applicants must demonstrate that they have already committed some resources (funds, labor, materials) to initiate their project.

reporting.quote: send periodic updates on project progress. These updates may be requested weekly, monthly, or bimonthly depending on project duration.

documents.quote: Non-profits must be able to provide documentation of their non-profit status. Schools and other types of organization/associations must provide a document that shows the constitution or establishment of this entity.
